description: ISU-ILCC Battery Aging Dataset is a dataset listed in Open Energy Hub (ORNL), an energy-sector data hub, published or maintained by Oak Ridge National Laboratory for the U.S. DOE Office of Electricity. The ISU-ILCC battery aging dataset was collected jointly by the System Reliability and Safety Laboratory at Iowa State University (ISU), now the Reliability Engineering and Informatics Laboratory (REIL) at the University of Connecticut, and Iowa Lakes Community College (ILCC). Coverage: the United States. The portal files it under Electricity, Education, Training, Research, Teaching. Its keywords are battery life, lithium ion batteries, charge rate, discharge rate. The portal shows 2024-06-20 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oeh-open-data-portal.
